connector.name: Artifacts by kuyazee
connector.registryDescription: Self-hosted artifact publishing: POST HTML/JSX/Markdown/zip, get an unguessable URL on your domain
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image artifacts:latest. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kuyazee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ARTIFACTS_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer token required for all writes and the MCP endpoint

env.name: BASE_URL
env.description: Public origin used in returned artifact URLs (e.g. https://artifacts.example.com)
